```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Data: https://ourworldindata.org/economic-inequality
income <- readr::read_csv("2025/data/income-share-of-the-richest-1.csv")
plot_data <- income |>
  dplyr::rename(Income = `Income share of the richest 1% (before tax) (World Inequality Database)`) |>
  dplyr::filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2023)) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Country, "(WID)", negate = TRUE),
    Country != "World"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Country = stringr::str_remove(Country, " \\(country\\)")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Continent = countrycode::countrycode(
      sourcevar = Country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "continent"
    )
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(Continent == "Europe") |> 
  dplyr::select(-Continent) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = Income
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Change = `2023` - `2022`)
ojs_define(plot_data = plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
d3 = require("d3@7")
```

```{ojs}
r_data = transpose(plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
chart = {

  const data = d3.sort(r_data, d => d.Change)

  // Specify the chart’s dimensions.
  const barHeight = 25;
  const marginTop = 80;
  const marginRight = 60;
  const marginBottom = 35;
  const marginLeft = 60;
  const height = Math.ceil((data.length + 0.1) * barHeight) + marginTop + marginBottom;

  // Create the positional scales.
  const x = d3.scaleLinear()
    .domain(d3.extent(data, d => d.Change))
    .rangeRound([marginLeft, width - marginRight]);

  const y = d3.scaleBand()
    .domain(data.map(d => d.Country))
    .rangeRound([marginTop, height - marginBottom])
    .padding(0.1);

  // Create the SVG container.
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto; font: 10px sans-serif;");

  // Add a rect for each country.
  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll()
    .data(data)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("fill", (d) => d3.schemeRdBu[3][d.Change < 0 ? 2 : 0])
      .attr("x", (d) => x(Math.min(d.Change, 0)))
      .attr("y", (d) => y(d.Country))
      .attr("width", d => Math.abs(x(d.Change) - x(0)))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());

  // Add a text label for each country.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("font-family", "sans-serif")
      .attr("font-size", 10)
    .selectAll()
    .data(data)
    .join("text")
      .attr("text-anchor", d => d.Change < 0 ? "end" : "start")
      .attr("x", (d) => x(d.Change) + Math.sign(d.Change - 0) * 4)
      .attr("y", (d) => y(d.Country) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("dy", "0.35em")
      .text(d => d.Change);

  // Add the axes and grid lines.
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(0,${marginTop})`)
    .call(d3.axisTop(x).ticks(width / 80))
    .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick line").clone()
          .attr("y2", height - marginTop - marginBottom)
          .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.1))
    .call(g => g.select(".domain").remove());

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("transform", `translate(${x(0)},0)`)
    .call(d3.axisLeft(y).tickSize(0).tickPadding(6))
    .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick text").filter((d, i) => data[i].Change < 0)
        .attr("text-anchor", "start")
        .attr("x", 6));
        
  // Title
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", 0)           
    .attr("y", 15)
    .attr("text-anchor", "left")  
    .style("font-size", "16px") 
    .text("Change in share of income received by the richest 1% of the population.");

  // Subtitle
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", 0)           
    .attr("y", 35)
    .attr("text-anchor", "left")  
    .style("font-size", "10px") 
    .text("This chart shows the change between 2022 and 2023. Negative values indicate a more equal distribution of wealth.");
    
  // Caption
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", 0)           
    .attr("y", height - 5)
    .attr("text-anchor", "left")  
    .style("font-size", "10px") 
    .text("Data: World Inequality Database (WID). Processed by Our World in Data.");


  return svg.node();
}
```
